subject.title: [Feature]: Per-bot context isolation in multi-bot Feishu groups - only record context when mentioned

question: Should Feishu add a mention-targeted context isolation mode, and should it be a new explicit config policy or a changed meaning of requireMention for skipped group history?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but changing skipped-message history affects documented group behavior and adding context policy expands public Feishu config.

options.title: Explicit Feishu Context Policy
options.body: Add a Feishu-owned context policy such as mention-only/per-bot isolation while preserving current skipped-history defaults unless the operator opts in.

options.title: Redefine requireMention
options.body: Make requireMention stop recording unmentioned messages by default, accepting the compatibility change for existing group-history users.

options.title: Defer To Broader Group Targeting
options.body: Keep Feishu unchanged until a generic multi-agent target-attribution contract such as the one in the related group-context issue lands.

recommendation.title: Explicit Feishu Context Policy
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu-owned context policy such as mention-only/per-bot isolation while preserving current skipped-history defaults unless the operator opts in.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current Feishu identity/context reviewer signal from recent code and related PR review history.
